description_en: Updates a policy rule instance in a specified cluster. You can modify the governance action (alert or block) and the scope of namespaces to which the policy instance applies
description_zh: 您可以调用ModifyPolicyInstance接口，在指定集群中更新策略规则实例，调整策略实例的治理动作（告警或拦截）、作用的命名空间范围等
kebab_example: aliyun cs modify-policy-instance --cluster-id c8155823d057948c69a0000 --policy-name ACKAllowedRepos --action deny --instance-name allowed-repos-cbhhb --namespaces test3 --parameters restrictedNamespaces_:_test --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPolicyInstance

parameters.description_en: The ID of the target cluster.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the target cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.description_en: The name of the policy governance rule.
parameters.help_en: The name of the policy governance rule
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.description_en:
The governance action of the rule. Valid values:

- `deny`: Blocks non-compliant deployments.
- `warn`: Generates an alert.
parameters.description_zh:
规则治理动作，取值：

- `deny`：拦截违规部署
- `warn`：告警
